clue.text: Savoury pancake: season, then toss

parts.note: spring is one of the four seasons
to toss and roll are both to turn over and over, as in bed

explanation.surface: A recipe step: season the pancake, then flip it in the pan.
explanation.walkthrough: 'toss' suggests flipping a pancake, but it gives a word for tumbling over.
explanation.definitionFit: A spring roll is a filled, rolled pastry wrapper fried until crisp, a savoury pancake of Chinese cooking.

clue.text: Pot may cause crowd to quarrel

parts.note: a jam is a crowd packed tightly together
a jar is an old word for a quarrel or clash

explanation.surface: A pot of some sort supposedly sets a crowd arguing.
explanation.definitionFit: A glass container for preserves is a kind of pot.

clue.text: Talk at length after knave produces hare

indicators.note: the talking word comes after the card word in the answer

parts.note: the knave in a pack of cards is also called the jack
to rabbit (on) is British slang for chatter on and on

explanation.surface: A rogue's long-winded talk somehow conjures up a hare.
explanation.walkthrough: To rabbit on is British slang for talking endlessly.
explanation.definitionFit: The North American jackrabbit is in fact a species of hare, not a true rabbit.

clue.text: Clerical dignitary removing hat immediately

indicators.note: in a down entry the hat is the top letter, so the first letter of the cleric's title is dropped

parts.note: a canon is a senior member of a cathedral's clergy

explanation.surface: A churchman takes his hat off at once.
explanation.definitionFit: Anon is an archaic word meaning soon or at once, as in 'I'll be there anon'.

clue.text: Book about extremely nonconformist island, legendary one

indicators.note: the book word goes about, i.e. around, the other letters

parts.note: an atlas is a book of maps

indicators.note: only the outermost letters of the word nonconformist are used

explanation.surface: A book about some rebellious island, a legendary one at that.
explanation.definitionFit: Atlantis is the mythical sunken island described by Plato, a legendary place.

clue.text: Piece of furniture, up to now unfinished

indicators.note: the phrase is left without its final letter

parts.note: so far means up to now

explanation.surface: An item of furniture that, so far, has not been completed.
explanation.definitionFit: A sofa is an upholstered couch, a common piece of furniture.

clue.text: Former prime minister's collection of butterflies?

definitions.meaning: belonging to Edward Heath, UK Prime Minister 1970-74
a group of small brown butterflies, such as the small heath; the question mark flags the playful plural

explanation.surface: A one-time premier's butterfly collection.
explanation.walkthrough: Edward Heath was a British Conservative prime minister in the 1970s.
explanation.definitionFit: Heath is a former British premier's surname, and several brown butterflies are called heaths.

clue.text: Pray the Pope has a go in broadcast

indicators.note: broadcast as in scattered widely, so these letters are strewn into a new order

parts.words: the Pope has a go in

explanation.surface: The Pontiff has a turn on the radio or TV.
explanation.walkthrough: 'broadcast' looks like the Pope going on air, but it signals the anagram.
explanation.definitionFit: To hope against hope is to keep wishing when things look hopeless, much like praying for a miracle.

clue.text: Advance warning given by senior teachers in revolt

parts.note: heads are head teachers, the senior staff of schools
a people that is up, or up in arms, is in revolt

explanation.surface: Head teachers in rebellion give notice of their plans.
explanation.definitionFit: A heads-up is an informal alert given beforehand.

clue.text: Boxer from California

indicators.note: the boxer's name is taken from within the state name

explanation.surface: A fighter who comes from the Golden State.
explanation.definitionFit: Muhammad Ali was a heavyweight champion boxer.

clue.text: In all seriousness, Jet's leader sounds good in good American role

indicators.note: a leader is the first letter of the word Jet's

parts.note: saying sounds good is saying OK
a part is a role in a play or film

explanation.surface: A jet pilot's commander approves a fine role in an American production.
explanation.definitionFit: Joking apart is a phrase meaning seriously, said when setting humour aside.

clue.text: Cake ingredient from Prague, peeled, brought back by son

parts.note: S is the genealogical abbreviation for son

indicators.note: the remaining letters are brought back, read in reverse
peeled means the outer letters of Prague are stripped away

explanation.surface: A baker's son fetches an ingredient home from a trip to Prague.
explanation.walkthrough: 'peeled' strips P and E to leave RAGU, which 'brought back' turns into UGAR.
explanation.definitionFit: Sugar is a sweetener used in almost every cake recipe.

clue.text: Rare thing at golf club, right, during a defeat?

indicators.note: the club and right letters come during, i.e. inside, the other words

parts.note: a loss is a defeat
a bat is a club, as used in cricket or baseball

explanation.surface: A golfer's rare feat with the right club, in the middle of a losing round.
explanation.definitionFit: In golf an albatross is three under par on a hole, a very rare score.

clue.text: Dessert made by French chef, male with short temper

parts.note: Raymond Blanc is a celebrated French chef working in Britain

indicators.note: short means the word loses its last letter

parts.note: anger is temper

explanation.surface: A pudding made by a hot-tempered French cook.
explanation.walkthrough: Raymond Blanc is a French-born chef famous in Britain for his restaurant and TV shows.
explanation.definitionFit: Blancmange is a sweet, set milk pudding, a dessert.

clue.text: Likely to happen in short dance that's exotic

indicators.note: something exotic is strange and foreign, so these letters take on an unfamiliar arrangement

explanation.surface: A brief, exotic dance is probably on its way.
explanation.definitionFit: Something on the cards is probable, as if foretold by fortune-telling cards.

clue.text: Pithy saying in abridged OT book

indicators.note: abridged means cut short, so the title loses its last letter

parts.note: Proverbs is a book of the Old Testament

explanation.surface: A short wise remark found in a condensed Old Testament book.
explanation.definitionFit: A proverb is a short, well-known saying expressing a truth.

clue.text: Record poems describing one's events

indicators.note: describing in its sense of drawing a line round, so these words enclose the rest

parts.note: an EP is an extended-play record
odes are lyric poems
one's is I plus S, I being one

explanation.surface: A record of poems that tells of one's life.
explanation.definitionFit: Episodes are incidents or events in a sequence.

clue.text: Former French region — a French article about it when in Revolution?

indicators.note: the article goes about, i.e. around, the other letters

parts.note: la is the French feminine definite article

indicators.note: in Revolution means the following words are turned backwards

parts.note: taken as written
as can mean when, as in 'as he left'

explanation.surface: A puzzle about a French region during the Revolution.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in Revolution' reads like the French Revolution of history, but it signals reading backwards, making SATI.
explanation.definitionFit: Alsatia is the old Latin-style name for Alsace, the region on France's border with Germany.

clue.text: Stiff examination?

parts.note: a stiff is slang for a corpse, so the stiff examination is not a hard test but an inspection of a dead body

explanation.surface: A tough exam.
explanation.definitionFit: A post-mortem is a medical examination of a dead body to find the cause of death.

clue.text: Projectile, large, is located in sea

indicators.note: the large and is letters are located inside the sea's name

parts.note: the Baltic is a sea in northern Europe

explanation.surface: A big missile is found in the sea.
explanation.definitionFit: Ballistic means relating to projectiles, as in a ballistic missile, so it serves as the adjective.

clue.text: Composer has supporters surrounding him, but not I

indicators.note: the supporters go surrounding the other letters

parts.note: bras are supporting undergarments

indicators.note: but not means the following letter is removed from the word him

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A composer has his backers gathered round him, though not himself.
explanation.definitionFit: Johannes Brahms was a German Romantic composer.

clue.text: Spy, a well-bred chap

parts.note: a gent is a gentleman

explanation.surface: An intelligence operative who is a well-mannered gentleman.
explanation.definitionFit: An agent is a secret operative, a spy.

clue.text: Approach a meeting place

parts.note: a venue is a place where people gather

explanation.surface: Drawing near a place where people meet.
explanation.definitionFit: An avenue can mean a way of approach, such as a tree-lined drive to a house.

clue.text: Fitting finger

definitions.meaning: to finger can mean to pilfer or take, as in seizing something for oneself

explanation.definitionFit: Appropriate is an adjective meaning suitable and a verb meaning to take something without permission.

clue.text: Way of parking at hotel

parts.note: P is the road-sign abbreviation for parking
H is hotel in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: A route for parking at a hotel.
explanation.definitionFit: A path is a track or route, a way from one place to another.

clue.text: Runs over to assist attack

indicators.note: in a down entry the runs letter sits over the help word

parts.note: R is the cricket abbreviation for runs
to aid is to assist

explanation.surface: Someone runs across to help in an assault.
explanation.definitionFit: A raid is a sudden attack on a target.

clue.text: File doesn't include river snake

indicators.note: the tool's name is left without the river letter

parts.note: a rasp is a coarse file

explanation.surface: A tool that leaves out a river snake.
explanation.definitionFit: The asp is a venomous Egyptian cobra, a snake.

clue.text: Astounding rhyme represented part of Lent

indicators.note: represented in the sense of presented afresh, these letters are set out again in a new order

explanation.surface: An amazing verse reworked as part of the Lenten season.
explanation.definitionFit: Mothering Sunday, the British Mother's Day, falls on the fourth Sunday in Lent.
